mechanics.fact: Pac holds STEADY to stabilize two bridges, power the core ferry and open Isp's route; Isp's STOP opens Pac's console and stops the ferry. Isp latches RESCUE to keep gates open/power the ferry, then holds blue TARGET to stabilize bridges/open Pac finish. Pac crosses the lower gap to orange TARGET. Both hold targets together for two seconds. Bubble and boomerang attacks recur; blue TARGET interrupts the bubble once and STEADY interrupts the boomerang once. Slime lies below moving/bridge route and the tumor core pulses below the bridge.

missed_mechanics: STOP opens Pac console/stops core ferry; STEADY powers ferry and stabilizes both bridges; RESCUE opens gates and interrupts/powers once; blue target opens Pac route and interrupts Gem once; Pac must jump lower gap to orange target; simultaneous hold charges for two seconds.
incorrect_inferences: Pass one treated dialogue's bridge question and STEADY interruption as ambiguous; source confirms their specific route effects, but that source knowledge does not improve what a first-time player can infer.
changed_judgments: Reasoning rises 2->4 and cooperation 3->4 because the full route requires STOP, STEADY, RESCUE, blue TARGET, then simultaneous two-second targets. Execution rises 2->3 for the ferry, upper bubble route, and lower gap. Timing stays 1: two seconds is a hold duration, not a deadline; attacks have repeatable warning cycles. Hazards resolve from unknown to 2 due slime under required traversals and the pulsing core below the bridge. Novelty stays 3. Recovery resolves to 2 because a missed target resets charge and requires repeating part of the route. Clarity stays 1: the shutdown itself is directly stated; source route knowledge adds no cue.
unresolved: Whether players infer the required order among STOP, STEADY, RESCUE, blue TARGET, and Pac's lower target from standing cues.
Fall/contact retry consequences and actual novice ability to coordinate the two-second hold.

single_operator_note: A single operator must switch heroes for separate route controls, keep one hero on each target during the charge, then switch again to exits; this exceeds the two-human baseline and is not folded into scores.
